modules.name: Cone registry, origins and versioning
modules.design_question: Which protected views apply at a location, where exactly is each origin, its elevation and field of view, and which version of each cone is this?
modules.method: Load the City ViewCone layer (EPSG:26910, 24 polygons) and cross-check the open-data GeoJSON (GRS80 UTM conversion matches the service to 0.01 m). Store rings, not triangles: 23 have three vertices, cone 28 has five. Vertex 0 is the origin; sibling cones share it exactly (3.2.1/3.2.3/3.2.4, 9.1/9.2, B1/B2, G1/G2, J1/J2, 27.1/27.2; 3.2.2 differs 0.33 m), giving the 16 origins the City lists. The two extreme rays are the vertical boundaries; the far edge is only a clip, except K. Version each cone by geometry hash, attribute hash and governing Council report. Timestamps are metadata only: dataLastEditDate equals schemaLastEditDate to the millisecond, the open-data modified date is a routine extract, EFFECTIVE_DATE is unreliable. Polygon hashes miss lower-boundary-only amendments (H and 3.2.4, Dec 2025), so also hash each PVG PDF and read Council decisions. Audit landmark bearings: a boundary on a parcel corner must equal the bearing from the apex to that corner (H, J2, 28, 9.1 west agree within 0.05 degrees). Test points in projected metres with a 1.5 m edge band. Downtown and CBD subsets need digitised City boundaries; the boxes are test boxes only.

Council reports S06, S07, S08, S42, S49, S50

modules.name: Maximum-height surface engine
modules.design_question: What is the highest permitted geodetic elevation at every location, which cone governs, and where is the answer unknown?
modules.method: Per cone, within its wedge, compute candidates from one k: radial Z_r = Lv + k_r*|p - O| and planar Z_a = Lv + k_a*((p - O) . u), u the wedge bisector, each in three curvature forms: plane; reference-anchored chord (minus (1-kappa)*d*(Dr-d)/2R); eye-angle line (plus (1-kappa)*d^2/2R); kappa 0.13, R 6371 km. Default per cone is the lowest valid candidate, so the chord where a reference exists. Surface Z = minimum over parameterised cones in geodetic metres; no relaxation or aviation cap enters. Where any covering wedge lacks parameters, mark the cell INCOMPLETE; keep the argmin only as a partial answer and never show a clean value. Keep argmin and coverage rasters (cone, clause, class). City rezoning policy sets maximum height to the underside of the most restrictive view cone, which supports the minimum. Store parameters (about 2 KB) and render on demand: a 2 m grid over the 4 km2 CBD is about 1 M cells in a Web Worker. Curvature form is a per-cone flag. Outside every polygon no view limit applies.

modules.name: Vertical datum, frames and grade conversion
modules.design_question: How do geodetic cone heights relate to terrain, building base surface and the user's model so heights compare correctly?
modules.method: The PVG say geodetic without naming a datum (s.2, p.3). City LiDAR 2022 is CGVD28GVRD on the Metro Vancouver geoid (HTMVBC00, the renamed HTGVRDBC00) and BC legal surveys still use CGVD28 (LTSA CL 465C): treat cone heights as CGVD28 (assumption, flagged). Ground: City LiDAR 2022 bare earth (0.081 m, 95%); 1 km tiles, zipped LAS 16.45 MB to 2.74 GB; fall back to the City 2013 DEM. LidarBC, HRDEM and MRDEM use CGVD2013; the CDEM uses CGVD28. Convert with a point value from NRCan GPS-H (CGG2013a, HT2.0), about +0.15 m (preliminary 2013); the MRDEM spec records a 2025 change in transformation method of about 0.4 m, so store method and date per tile. Compare absolute elevations: City sheets give geodetic = base-surface elevation + height (1070 Barclay: 178.10 = 41.38 + 136.72). Horizontal: service labelled EPSG:26910; LiDAR is NAD83(CSRS) 4.0.0.BC.1.GVRD (about 0.1 m apart per Esri Canada). Check each origin Lv against LiDAR ground at the apex. Uploaded models: user states one known geodetic Z; store dZ. Tiles: uint16 with offset, centimetres for the CBD, decimetres for regional terrain; record datum and geoid per tile.

modules.name: Design-versus-cone checker and clause warnings
modules.design_question: Does an uploaded model or massing break a view cone, by how much, which guideline clause applies, and where can no answer be given?
modules.method: Convert uploads (Rhino 3dm via rhino3dm, OBJ, IFC via web-ifc) to the shared frame with the M04 transform. For each wedge meeting the model footprint, clip meshes and roof faces to it and compute penetration p = max over the clipped geometry of z - Z(x, y), including appurtenances (clause 3.1.1). Evaluate vertices, wedge-clip points, the foot of the perpendicular from the origin on each edge, and a dense sample on sloped faces; report the argmax. Per-cone status: INTERSECTS (p over 0.1 m), BOUNDARY (within 0.1 m), CLEAR, or IN CONE - NO ESTIMATE when the cone has no calibrated parameters. Overall result is the worst status over all covering wedges; CLEAR only if every covering wedge is estimated and clear. For NO ESTIMATE show cone ID, clause 3.1.1 and a prompt to request a City View Cone Assessment. Mark points beyond the calibrated distance range as extrapolated. Cite 3.1.1; 3.1.2-3.1.4 minor encroachments (pp.6-7); 3.1.5 hardship, at most 2 m (p.7); 3.3 view shadows (p.7); 3.4 Exceptional Downtown Sites (pp.7-8) through the M06 mask. Never auto-classify minor elements, hardship or view shadows. Every result carries the standing banner.

modules.name: Relaxations, zoning and aviation obligations
modules.design_question: Which relaxations may apply by clause, and which zoning limits and federal aviation obligations apply to a downtown tower?
modules.method: Relaxations are not caps. The Higher Buildings Policy (31 Mar 2026) lets selected buildings enter QE view 3 and other approved corridors; heights (about 550-700 ft in the CBD) are guidance. Exceptional Downtown Sites (PVG 3.4; at least 8,000 m2) may also enter B1, B2, D and 12.2 (removed from Table 1 on 4 June 2025) and must keep views to the Lions; no relief from A, E, 9.x, J1, G or H. Per-cone masks are user-switched, never automatic. Zoning caps are typed from by-laws. Aviation is rule-based. CAR 601.23(1): obstacle if (a) above an obstacle limitation surface (TP 312E ch.4), (b) over 90 m AGL within 6 km of an aerodrome centre, (c) over 90 m AGL within 3.7 km of a recognised VFR route, (d) over 150 m AGL; 601.24 notice (form 26-0427), Standard 621. AC 601-007: basic 60 m AGL; heliport 4% to 1,500 m from the FATO edge; water aerodrome with defined channels is runway-type, 2% to 3,000 m (4.7(2)); certified 1% to 6,000 m; no channels 60 m AGL. Classify CYHC and CBC7 from CWAS and CFS; while unknown, warn on the lowest surface. YVR zoning covers Richmond only. NAV CANADA outcomes are user-entered caps.

modules.name: Validation harness against City height sheets
modules.design_question: How do we prove the estimated surface matches the City's own numbers, separate fit from prediction, and keep proving it as the City amends views?
modules.method: Three suites. Regression (in-sample): current City values (A 4 points, 3.2.3 5 points; 3 Oct 2024 sheet) fitted k, so passing shows only that code reproduces its fit; the build fails when a residual exceeds 0.1 m. Prediction (held-out): City points used in no fit; none exist yet, so report none. Historical, never gating: 9.2 points (pre-Feb 2026 origin), 1070 Barclay 3.2.1 and repealed 12.1.1 (2019), 2004 formula rows (datum unknown, algebra only), 1133 W Georgia (2005, about 100.58 m, plus or minus 2 m), superseded Council values. Every value carries cone, origin, boundary definition, report and date. Report fit residuals and hold-out errors separately. Structural tests: a point in an unparameterised wedge never returns CLEAR. Monthly job: diff geometry and attribute hashes of the ViewCone layer and the SHA-256 of the PVG PDF; log timestamps only as metadata; read Council decisions naming 'Public View', since H and 3.2.4 changed lower boundaries only. Request about 20 City assessments: near and far pairs at least 1 km apart, two off-axis points per cone, one held-out point per cone. Transcribe numbers and coordinates only. Coarse check: RTS 16338 App G sheets give parcel counts and mean height change per amended view.

modules.name: Viewpoint camera and lower-boundary overlay
modules.design_question: How should a design be viewed from each protected origin with the cone boundaries drawn as the City draws them?
modules.method: Place the camera at the origin (X, Y) at height Lv. Evidence suggests Lv is already eye level (1.4-3.5 m above 2002 contour ground at eight origins), so add 0 m by default and expose eye height. Aim along the cone bisector; set the field of view from the two boundary bearings plus a margin; draw vertical boundaries at the bearings. City sheets draw each cone as a yellow box on a photograph (RTS 16338 App G): in a rectilinear photograph a horizontal line is a plane through the eye (planar model), in a cylindrical panorama a radial cone. Render both and compare with the City reference photos before choosing. Apply Earth curvature and refraction (kappa 0.13) to distant terrain: drop = (1-kappa)d^2/2R, about 15 m at Hollyburn (15 km), 33 m at 22 km and 43 m at 25 km (the Lions). Rooftop viewpoints use the same camera class. Use City photos only as links, not copies. Check the view 20 apex against both origin descriptions.

flags.claim: A cone's lower boundary is a flat plane at one constant geodetic height.
flags.correction: It is a rising sight line: Z = Lv + k*D.
flags.detail: PVG 'horizontal lower boundary' means horizontal in the view. City 2004 formula and current sheet points fit one k per cone: A 0.0589, 3.2.3 0.0004; the 9.2 value is now historical.

flags.claim: Vista README: origins can only be estimated from polygon geometry.
flags.correction: The polygon apex is the City's origin coordinate; sibling cones share it exactly and the City layer adds Lv.
flags.detail: 24 polygons give 16 apexes, matching the City's 16 origin points. Survey accuracy of the apex is unstated; 9.x apex are whole metres.

flags.claim: Cone heights are published nowhere, so no height test is possible.
flags.correction: No surface is published, but reference parameters appear in Council reports for several cones and the City issues per-site geodetic sheets.
flags.detail: In force now: 28, H, J2 printed; 27.1 and 27.2 parcel-located; A and 3.2.3 fitted; 3.2.4 equals 3.2.3. Service REFERENCE_* fields are empty for all 24.

flags.claim: YVR or harbour obstacle surfaces cap downtown heights.
flags.correction: YVR zoning (SOR/80-902) covers Richmond lands only; no zoning found for the harbour aerodrome or heliport.
flags.detail: Correct for zoning surfaces, but CAR 601.23 and AC 601-007 still apply to towers; NAV CANADA decisions are not public (Holborn, July 2026: about 27 m cut).

flags.claim: City sheet points all lie within 4 degrees of cone axes, so radial and axial distance cannot be separated.
flags.correction: 9.2 points lie 6.0-6.3 degrees off the bisector (A 0.5-1.9, 3.2.3 3.1-3.7). Planar fits better: A 0.012 vs 0.037 m, 9.2 0.008 vs 0.024 m.
flags.detail: Separation is modest (about 3x, under 0.05 m) and 9.2 is historical. Default to the lower of both rules until an off-axis City sheet or City confirmation.

flags.claim: 9.2 is calibrated (k 0.0488) for the current cone.
flags.correction: The sheet predates the Feb 2026 origin move; k belongs to the Walking Figures origin and is historical.
flags.detail: RTS 18292 App A pp.12-13 moves 9.1 and 9.2 to the City Hall campus stairs; the service apex and VIEWPOINT_LOCATION show the new origin. 9.2 removed from the calibrated count.

flags.claim: 20 published points currently fit within 0.07 m.
flags.correction: 9 current points on 2 cones (A 4, 3.2.3 5), in-sample; 3 points (9.2) are stale; the 8 Barclay values are not fitted.
flags.detail: Fit residual is not validation. Leave-one-out: A 0.017 m planar, 3.2.3 0.004 m; none tests extrapolation beyond 48 m.

flags.claim: The Higher Buildings Policy supplies height caps to include in the minimum surface.
flags.correction: It is a relaxation: Higher Buildings may enter QE view 3 and named corridors; heights are approximate guidance. PVG 3.4.2 lets Exceptional Downtown Sites also enter B1, B2, D, 12.2.
flags.detail: Modelled as user-enabled per-cone masks with clause and reason; never part of the minimum.

flags.claim: Trout Lake 27.1 and 27.2 have published lower-boundary parameters (59.8 m and 54.3 m at 495340.12, 5456431.39).
flags.correction: 59.8 and 54.3 m are in force, measured from the 1975 E 12th NE corner (parcel vertex 495332.94, 5456355.10). The printed coordinates belong to proposed 27.2 at 2670 Victoria Dr (68.9 m, not adopted).
flags.detail: Printed text sits in the Proposed column (x=322). k becomes 27.1 0.04533 and 27.2 0.03685. The critique's 'adopted 68.9 m, no coordinates' is also wrong.

flags.claim: Service polygons already hold 2026 Trout Lake boundaries and Council adopted them on 4 Feb 2026.
flags.correction: Council referred the Trout Lake amendments back (RTS 19750 p.4); service 27.1/27.2 equal the pre-2026 corner bearings.
flags.detail: Review continues; City page still shows 2024 reference images. PVG Table 1 still prints 'Amended 2026' for 27.x.

flags.claim: The far edge of each cone is a clip near Burrard Inlet, and all 24 cones are triangles.
flags.correction: Cone 28 has five vertices; K looks south to City Hall and its far edge is the subject boundary.
flags.detail: Store rings; take the two extreme rays as vertical boundaries.

flags.claim: No aviation rule applies downtown; it is case-by-case only.
flags.correction: No zoning surface, but CAR 601.23 makes any structure above 150 m AGL an obstacle (above 90 m within 6 km of an aerodrome); 601.24 requires notice and Standard 621 marking.
flags.detail: Competition towers are 244-305 m; CYHC and CBC7 lie within about 2 km of the CBD; AC 601-007 notification starts at 60 m AGL.

flags.claim: EFFECTIVE_DATE identifies the cone version.
flags.correction: Only view 28 shows 2026-02-04; 9.1, 9.2, H, J2 and 3.2.4 changed in 2025-26 yet show 2024-07-10.
flags.detail: Version by geometry hash, layer edit dates (2026-05-05, 2026-04-15) and Council report.

flags.claim: The 9.2 'roof of 485 W 8th Ave' test shows that roof alignments cannot give Lr.
flags.correction: The test paired the new apex with old-origin data and ignored a 15 m ground fall to 8th Ave; implied roof 43 m ASL is about 27 m above ground.
flags.detail: Roof route restored using LiDAR 2022 roofs; check the roof rule on A (1008 Cambie, implied 84 m ASL).

flags.claim: Radial distance is always the less conservative choice.
flags.correction: It depends on the reference bearing: Clinton Park planar is 1.0 m higher on axis at 1 km but 0.6 m lower at the edge; 27.2 planar is 4.3 m higher on axis at 1 km.
flags.detail: Use the lower of radial and planar. The axis could be the bisector, the bearing to the reference, or perpendicular to the boundary; only an off-axis City sheet settles it.

flags.claim: QE 3.2.3 fits a near-level plane at Lv plus eye height.
flags.correction: Slope is 0.00045 +/- 0.00008 (about 5 sigma from zero), so not level; a level sightline at Lv + 0.4 m with Earth curvature fits equally.
flags.detail: Curvature is 1.2 m at 3.9 km (1.0 m with refraction 0.13). A City point near 5.8 km would separate the two (about 0.6 m).

flags.claim: Eye height used at origins.
flags.correction: Not published. Lv exceeds 2002 contour ground by 1.4-3.5 m at A, B1, D, J1, 20, 21, 27, 28 (about 0 at 9.x), suggesting Lv is eye level.
flags.detail: Free-intercept fits give intercept = Lv + 0.3 m (A) and Lv - 0.2 m (3.2.3), excluding an extra 1.6 m. Camera default adds 0 m.

flags.claim: Slope distance D is radial from the origin.
flags.correction: Radial is the 2004 formula wording; a planar (axial) boundary is the City overlay geometry and fits the sheet better.
flags.detail: Default is min of both. Clinton Park, J2 and 27.2 references lie 8-26 degrees off axis, so the choice moves heights by metres.

flags.claim: A single smooth surface per cone.
flags.correction: 3.2.1 gives 123.201 m at one Barclay point but about 143.3 m at the rest.
flags.detail: Old sub-sections or stepped lower boundaries may exist (2011 report splits views into sub-cones). RTS 16338 App B shows 3.2.1 geometry unamended in 2024.

flags.claim: Named 'roof level' alignments give Lr directly.
flags.correction: Plausible via LiDAR 2022 roofs with the maximum-elevation-angle rule; penthouse handling and roof epoch are untested.
flags.detail: Check on A: 1008 Cambie roof implied 84 m ASL (D 1.35 km). 9.2: 485 W 8th implied 43 m ASL (D 256 m).

flags.claim: View 12.2 (Granville Bridge) still exists.
flags.correction: Resolved in r2: Council deleted the Table 1 row on 4 June 2025 (RTS 16361); 3.4.2 still names 12.2; open data, City layer and pages have no 12.x view.
flags.detail: RTS 16338 Rec D (10 Jul 2024) ordered the review; the Jul 2024 PDF still had the row. Granville street-end view review goes to the Central Waterfront Plan.

flags.claim: Trout Lake 27.1/27.2 geometry after 4 Feb 2026.
flags.correction: In force: pre-2026 wedges with 59.8 m and 54.3 m. Staff proposals are referred back; the new outcome is pending.
flags.detail: Proposed wedges (27.1 -22.8 to -18.3 degrees; 27.2 -12.8 to 13.9) and 68.9 m are scenarios only; 2611 Victoria Dr referral (14 Jul 2026) awaits the review.

flags.claim: Cone 'geodetic' heights and VIEWPOINT_ELEVATION_M are CGVD28 GVRD.
flags.correction: PVG names no datum; inference from City LiDAR 2022 (CGVD28GVRD) and BC legal practice (CL 465C).
flags.detail: HTMVBC00 is the renamed HTGVRDBC00. CGVD2013 minus CGVD28 about +0.15 m (preliminary 2013); use point values from NRCan or GeoBC grids.

flags.claim: Basis of 100.58 m (330 ft) for View Cone D in 2005.
flags.correction: Report does not say if geodetic or above grade.
flags.detail: Test both readings once D is calibrated; informational with a plus or minus 2 m band.

flags.claim: Origin elevation 30.8 m for 9.x (service).
flags.correction: 2002 contours show 30-33 m within 5-20 m of the new apex, so 30.8 m is about ground; the 2004 figure (205 ft) was another origin.
flags.detail: Unknown whether Lv was updated when the origin moved in 2026; check against LiDAR 2022 ground.

flags.claim: The 2024 rewrite changed the QE cones, so the 2019 Barclay values are stale.
flags.correction: RTS 16338 App B shows 3.2.1-3.2.3 geometry unamended in 2024 (3.1 and 3.2.4a removed); 3.2.4 changed Dec 2025.
flags.detail: Barclay values stay non-gating until a current City assessment confirms them.

flags.claim: Web basemaps differ from the service frame by 1-1.5 m.
flags.correction: Esri Canada gives about 0.1 m between NAD83 original and CSRS at Vancouver; the WGS84 gap was not quantified.
flags.detail: The 1.5 m edge band is a design choice; record the realisation per layer.

flags.claim: Printed reference coordinates match the named parcel corner.
flags.correction: Printed 495,340.12, 5,456,431.39 is the NE vertex of 2670 Victoria Dr (0.11 m), not 1975 E 12th (76 m south).
flags.detail: Confirmed by PDF column position and the parcel layer; extraction order had misattributed it. 27.1/27.2 in-force references use the 1975 E 12th vertex.

flags.claim: The PVG PDF holds the current cone definitions.
flags.correction: Council says amendments go to the GIS model first; the PDF may lag and prints 'Amended 2026' for 27.x although those changes were referred back.
flags.detail: Treat the City layer and Council reports as authoritative; re-poll after each Council meeting. H is not labelled amended although Appendix K changed it (r2).

flags.claim: A CLEAR result means no protected view is broken.
flags.correction: Only PVG Table 1 cones are modelled; C-3A City Hall views, East Fraser Lands Mt Baker view, CD-1 (141) and the removed view 12.2 are not.
flags.detail: Standing banner on every result; r2 adds IN CONE - NO ESTIMATE for wedges without parameters.

flags.claim: Competition site may use the Exceptional Downtown Site route.
flags.correction: Area 11,468 m2 exceeds 8,000 m2 (3.4.1), but the route relaxes only QE 3, B1, B2 and D (12.2 is gone); A, E, 9.x, J1 still bind.
flags.detail: Criteria 3.4.4-3.4.8 are qualitative; the competition is hypothetical. Not a City determination.

flags.claim: View 20's lower-boundary reference is a building in West Vancouver, so it is roof-aligned (S3).
flags.correction: Treat it as terrain-referenced (S5): the 2024 definition is the uppermost extent of the 'English Properties' in West Vancouver, a hillside about 11 km north; the earlier boundary was the roof of 1763 Comox St.
flags.detail: RTS 16338 App B p.29 of 33 (PDF p.44). Take Lr from a North Shore DEM converted to CGVD28; carry a wide band; do not let 20 gate anything.

flags.claim: Whether view 12.2 was dropped or its Table 1 row omitted cannot be told; the change shows only in the Feb 2026 PDF.
flags.correction: Council deleted the row on 4 June 2025 (RTS 16361 App C); the Jun 2025 PDF already lacks it and 3.4.2's mention is vestigial.
flags.detail: PDF diff of Jul 2024 and Jun 2025 copies; PSPC minutes 4 June 2025 approve recommendation E (consequential amendments) and H (street-end view review).

flags.claim: The water aerodrome AC 601-007 notification surface is 60 m AGL.
flags.correction: 60 m AGL applies only without a defined water channel. With defined channels the aerodrome is runway-type (4.7(2)), 2% to 3,000 m; the heliport 4% surface is stated for heliports with instrument approach in 4.5.4 but generally in 4.5(1)(c).
flags.detail: Classify CYHC (channels, certification) from CWAS and CBC7 (IAP) from CFS; until then warn on the lowest surface. CAR 601.23(1)(a) and (c) added.

flags.claim: The service's 2026-04-15 'data edit' shows the cone geometry was edited.
flags.correction: dataLastEditDate equals schemaLastEditDate to the millisecond (1776247144052); use geometry and attribute hashes as the only edit evidence.
flags.detail: Open-data 'modified' equals the routine extract date. Queried 2026-10-21 from the FeatureServer layer JSON.

flags.claim: A roof-aligned lower boundary passes through the highest roof point.
flags.correction: It grazes the roof return with the maximum elevation angle (z - Lv)/D, usually a near parapet; penthouses are excluded unless named.
flags.detail: Penthouses are named only in vertical-boundary text (9.2 west: 500 W 10th; 22 west: 1182 Quebec); 'uppermost roof' wording is used for H and 3.2.4. Treat the penthouse rule as an assumption and test both.

flags.claim: View H's 58 m (Dec 2025) conflicts with the 2011 reference (40.64 m at 982.77 m), so H cannot be classed S1; Table 1 shows H unamended.
flags.correction: The 2011 H1 reference (corner of 501 Keefer St) is superseded. Appendix K sets H to 58 m at the Sun Yat-Sen pavilion; Council endorsed it 16 Dec 2025 (Rec K, vote 11268). Table 1 lacks the label.
flags.detail: App K said no table amendments; the Feb 2026 PDF labels J2 and 3.2.4 'Amended 2025' but not H. Lv 6.5 vs 7.2 m stays unexplained; the City must confirm 58 m because REFERENCE_* are null.

flags.claim: One curvature switch (drop D^2/2R), default off, is safe for the minimum surface.
flags.correction: The sign depends on the anchor: a line fixed at a far reference sits below linear interpolation by d(Dr-d)(1-kappa)/2R (plane overstates, up to 2.1 m for view 20); a line fixed by an angle at the eye rises by (1-kappa)d^2/2R.
flags.detail: Implement both per cone with kappa 0.13 and default to the lowest. Mountain renders drop 33 m at 22 km and 43 m at 25 km.

flags.claim: The checker's three outcomes CLEAR, BOUNDARY and INTERSECTS are exhaustive.
flags.correction: A wedge without calibrated parameters needs IN CONE - NO ESTIMATE; CLEAR is allowed only when every covering wedge is estimated and clear.
flags.detail: On the CBD test box 79.7% of cells touch a cone without parameters (7 of the 9 CBD cones have none).

flags.claim: Geometry hashes flag every amended view (H and 3.2.4 included).
flags.correction: H and 3.2.4 changed lower boundaries only (Dec 2025), so their polygons are unchanged; also hash the PVG PDF and read Council decisions naming 'Public View'.
flags.detail: Polygon-changing amendments in 2025-26: J2 (west boundary), 9.1, 9.2 (origin), 28 (new).

flags.claim: The worst penetration point is the point nearest the origin.
flags.correction: Penetration is the maximum over the clipped geometry of z - Z(x, y); under the radial rule it can fall at the foot of the perpendicular on an edge, or inside a sloped face.
flags.detail: Evaluate vertices, wedge-clip points, perpendicular feet and a dense sample on sloped faces; report the argmax.

flags.claim: int16 centimetre terrain tiles suit all terrain.
flags.correction: int16 cm caps at 327.67 m; North Shore peaks reach about 1,700 m. Use uint16 with offset: cm for the CBD, dm for regional tiles.
flags.detail: Record datum (CGVD2013 or CGVD28) and geoid per tile.

flags.claim: The printed 'English Properties' means the British Properties hillside in West Vancouver.
flags.correction: Council text prints 'English Properties'; the reference image (App G p.35) shows the lower box edge near the base of the mountains but names no neighbourhood.
flags.detail: Ask the City for the reference feature and its XY; distance about 11 km is the critique's estimate, not measured.

flags.claim: The H lower-boundary history is complete.
flags.correction: App K 'Current' H is the uppermost roof of 41 E Hastings St, while the 2011 report used a corner of 501 Keefer St; the step between them is not documented.
flags.detail: No H lower-boundary text found in RTS 16338 (H1 only renumbered). Service H Lv 7.2 vs 2011 Lv 6.5 may reflect an origin shift (stage centre vs north end of the plaza).

flags.claim: Refraction coefficient kappa is 0.13.
flags.correction: A common geodetic value; the City's own model and weather vary it.
flags.detail: Per-cone override; default lowest candidate surface until the City states its model.

flags.claim: The 2004 formula rows use the same datum as current cones.
flags.correction: Lv 205 ft (62.5 m) for an origin on Cambie looks high against local ground; datum or offset convention unknown.
flags.detail: Use the rows only to test the formula's algebra, never heights.

flags.claim: Image-derived k can stand in for missing S4 definitions.
flags.correction: RTS 16338 App G sheets and City photos draw yellow boxes 'as generally demonstrated'; accuracy is unmeasured and depends on resection quality.
flags.detail: Label image-derived, carry 0.05 degrees (1.7 m at 2 km) plus resection error, and confirm with City assessments.

unresolved_relationships: Lower-boundary reference for B1, B2, D, K, 10, 3.2.1, 3.2.2: no text in PVG, Council reports 2010-2026, open data or booklets; 21 is image-defined. 1989 and 2011 View Protection Guidelines sheets and DODP Map 4 not obtained (old URL redirects).

Roof elevations for E, G1, G2, J1, 9.1, 9.2, 22: the maximum-elevation-angle rule and LiDAR values are not yet run; roof existence in Sept 2022 unchecked; the reference for fitted A and 3.2.3 is unknown.

View 20: XY and elevation of the uppermost extent of the 'English Properties' are unpublished; spelling versus British Properties unverified; distance about 11 km is an estimate; CGVD2013 to CGVD28 offset for the North Shore not computed.

View H: the adopted 58 m (16 Dec 2025) cannot be seen in the GIS (REFERENCE_* null); Lv 6.5 (2011) versus 7.2 (service) unexplained; the step from the 501 Keefer corner to 'uppermost roof of 41 E Hastings' is undocumented.
